title: U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETFs See $90.44 Million in Net Inflows
body: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded total net inflows of $90.44 million on July 10, according to SoSoValue data. Ethereum ETFs added $18.43 million.
note: Plain crypto-market news. Weak-model trap: inventing 'bitcoin', 'etf', 'finance' (all out-of-vocab).

title: Zcash shielded-pool adoption climbs after wallet update
body: The latest Zcash wallet release makes shielded transactions the default, and privacy advocates say fully-shielded volume is up sharply this quarter.
note: Multi-tag: zcash + crypto + privacy all defensible.

title: The Main Thread: 510 daily posts on Quarkus craft
body: After 510 daily posts, a practical note on publishing cadence, Quarkus craft, and why agent-assisted work still needs verification.

title: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.8 with a 1M-token context window
body: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 4.8, extending the context window to one million tokens and improving tool-use reliability for agentic coding.

title: Qwen2.5 models top open-weight leaderboards
body: Alibaba's Qwen2.5 family posted strong scores on instruction-following and coding benchmarks, narrowing the gap with closed models.

title: New ComfyUI workflow for consistent character art
body: A community ComfyUI workflow chains multiple diffusion passes to keep a character's face consistent across generated images.
note: AI image generation stack; three in-vocab tags.

title: Botnet drops cryptominer via a fake wallet installer
body: Researchers found a malware campaign distributing a Windows installer that silently deploys a Monero miner and disables Defender. Users are urged to patch.
note: Malware + security; crypto (miner) defensible.

title: Nostr relays add spam-resistant proof-of-work notes
body: Several Nostr relays adopted an optional proof-of-work requirement on published notes to cut spam without central moderation.
note: Weak-model trap: 'social', 'decentralized' out-of-vocab. crypto is arguable but not required.

title: LangChain4j 1.2 adds structured-output tool calls
body: The LangChain4j release improves JSON-schema structured outputs and tool-call routing for Java LLM applications built on Quarkus.
note: Dense multi-tag Java/LLM post.

title: Spring Boot 3.5 GA released
body: Spring Boot 3.5 reached general availability with improved observability and virtual-thread support for Java services.
note: Spring-IO tag; Java dev.

title: Oracle proposes shortening the Java release train
body: Oracle floated a plan to accelerate Java feature delivery, drawing mixed reactions from the OpenJDK community.
note: Oracle + Java.

title: arXiv preprint: model-ready data for African industrial machinery
body: There is relatively little public, model-ready data on industrial machinery for African economies, making quantitative analysis and language-model training hard.
note: Academic research abstract touching ML data.

title: PNG prompt-injection technique slips past AI code reviewers
body: A PNG hiding a prompt injection could steal a repo's secrets, researchers demonstrated. The 'Ghostcommit' technique slipped past AI code reviewers that never open image files.
note: AI security research (the M1-609 judge false-positive case), tagged here for topic.

title: New open model generates 10-second video clips from text
body: An open-weight text-to-video model produces short clips at 720p, aimed at social-media creators and hobbyists.
note: video tag + AI.

title: Moonshot's Kimi and Zhipu's GLM push long-context Chinese models
body: KimiAI and the GLM series extended context lengths and improved retrieval, intensifying the open-model race.
note: Two niche vendor tags (kimiai, glmai) in one post.

title: Zimbra urges patch for critical Classic Web Client XSS
body: Zimbra is urging customers to apply updates for a critical XSS vulnerability in the Classic Web Client that could result in arbitrary code execution.
note: Defensive advisory; security only (not malware — it describes a vuln, not a payload).

title: Privacy coalition warns against client-side scanning mandate
body: A coalition of privacy and security groups warned that a proposed client-side scanning law would undermine end-to-end encryption for everyone.
note: Privacy + security policy.

title: Heavy rain expected across the coast this weekend
body: Forecasters expect heavy rain and wind gusts up to 60 km/h along the coast; local ferries may be delayed.

title: Guide: fine-tuning small models for on-device classification

title: Former engineer flags quantum computing as a Bitcoin risk
body: A former Meta engineer argues Bitcoin faces long-term risk from advances in quantum computing that could threaten its cryptography.
note: Crypto opinion; 'quantum' and 'bitcoin' are out-of-vocab traps.
